svg.title: The post-quantum bill
svg.desc: Leaf public key plus three signatures: 224 bytes with Ed25519, 8572 bytes with ML-DSA-44, about 38 times more.

text.tspan: leaf public key + 3 signatures, per handshake
(leaf signature by the CA + two transparency-log receipts)
about 38x more, before a single byte of web page
